title: Cave of the Casterwills/Quotes
summary:
"Lok, are you playing with your Holotome during class?" (LeBlanche)

"Uh... maybe." (Lok Lambert)

"That's about enough of that!"
- Dante Vale, while fighting Mallory and White

"Your friends are not Casterwills, and they are in grave danger."
- Nimue Casterwill to Sophie Casterwill

"When do we make our move sir?" (Stack) 

"Real soon, Avalon's power is just the thing i need to restore the Organization to its former glory." (Wilder)
